clips.title: The story
paras: Across the Barrens, Prowler Claws are carried back to Sergra Darkthorn at the Crossroads. They show that a hunter can track and defeat the prowlers stalking the plains.

Savannah Prowlers hide in the Barrens’ tall grass, waiting to strike with patience and cunning. These large cats ambush creatures that enter their hunting grounds, unlike grazing plainstriders and zhevra. Taking their curved claws means facing predators that rely on stealth and defend their territory. For Horde warriors and scouts, the hunt tests whether they can track a stalker through its own ground and make it the prey.

Sergra Darkthorn, the huntress at the Crossroads, asks initiates to bring back Prowler Claws before facing greater trials. The claws show that a hunter can follow tracks through the savannah grass and withstand a predator’s attack. Those who return with them have proved they can stay alert among the dangerous beasts of the plains.
